title: An Nvidia insider-turned-VC on why robotics hasn’t hit its ChatGPT moment, yet
hook_text: Robotics is in its Lego era
script:
Amulya Vishwanath spent seven years at Nvidia, where she led product marketing for robotics.
She managed the Nvidia Isaac platform, which provides tools for building AI-powered robots.
Vishwanath says robotics is currently in its Lego era, not its ChatGPT moment.
Engineers are still rebuilding basic building blocks like actuators and robotic hands.
Safety standards and software are also being rethought from the ground up.
Vishwanath now invests in companies tackling these fundamental robotics infrastructure challenges.
Do you think hardware or software is the bigger hurdle for robotics?
